I wish it was thousands sword flying around at enemies instead of a big ass sword just going down. We actually already got that with Aemeath's ult and it feels repetitive Also I wish Wuwa has more interesting ult, most characters have either transformation or single damage burst. So imagine tons of swords flying at enemies when you're rotating, Phrolova's ult style, it would be much cooler.    submitted by    /u/peerawitppr   [link]   [個のコメント]
